description:
This is our in-depth review of the all-new 7-seater MG S9. We’ll review the design, the interior, what it’s like to drive, and determine whether you should avoid, consider, shortlist, or buy it.

Explore new & used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-2206

This is the all-new MG S9, and it might just be the best value car you can buy in 2026! 

It’s a plug-in hybrid 7-seater, so Mat’s going to see if this budget-option MG has what it takes to compare with some of the most popular three-row SUVs around, such as the Chery Tiggo 8, Hyundai Ioniq 9, and Peugeot 5008! 

Starting with the design, there’s no denying that it looks anything like a budget option! There’s a large & wide grille up the front that gives the car presence on the road. Along the side, there are elements of chrome trim to help the car stand out, and around the back there’s a wraparound taillight (and unfortunately, a set of incredible fake exhaust tips). title: Why NOTHING can beat the new MG S9…
